Dims 7.6x3.625x8.1 in from Linen Plus (Canada) - the 8.1 in height looks large, verify. 9.0 Ah at 20V / 3.0 Ah at 60V. 60 V mode needs DC-DC for J501. Power-tool pack: typically no discharge-cutoff MOSFET in the pack; the tool reads the pack and does UV cutoff (estimate, not published). Robot MUST implement its own UVLO (~15 V for 5S, ~3.0 V/cell) and current limit. Continuous current not published by manufacturer. Needs a dock/adapter; latch gives fast hot-swap. Cell format/parallel count not published in fetched sources; series count inferred from brand voltage class (estimate). Dimensions corrected 2026-10-25 to 157 x 92 x 110 mm (the same pack as the 20 V-mode entries; 193 x 92 x 206 was a package size). Pack dims 138 x 87 x 97 mm and 1.46 kg come from DeWalt's datasheet for the DCB547 (EU name for the same 9 Ah FLEXVOLT pack); tool_batteries.json entries dewalt-dcb609-20v-mode and dewalt-2x-dcb609-20v-series still say 157 x 92 x 110 and should be updated to match. Not verified (2026-10-26): that DCB547 and DCB609 are dimensionally identical (DeWalt markets them as the same 9 Ah FLEXVOLT pack, but no single page states it); rail/terminal positions along L (no DeWalt drawing); which mass (1460 vs 1565 g) is correct.
